scenes.title: Monastery Chronicle
scenes.summary: Father Grigory scolds the monk Kostik for writing the chronicle too slowly and messily. Kostik says he feels afraid and his hand is going numb.

scenes.title: Attack on the Monastery
scenes.summary: As invaders burn the monastery walls, Kostik urges Father Grigory to flee. Grigory tells him to hide the chronicle in the stone cellar, and Kostik promises to save it.

scenes.title: The Monastery Wall
scenes.summary: A professor tells his students that an old wall is a historic monument. A builder arrives to demolish it for a shopping center, and the professor protests.

scenes.title: Leak from the Office
scenes.summary: Pasha and Vika learn that a secret video from his office is online. Vika says his career is over and leaves, while Pasha begs her to stay.

scenes.title: Comfort in the Kitchen
scenes.summary: Samson gives Nina tea and comforts her after the scandal. He promises they will cope, as they did in the nineties, and that he will never abandon his family.

scenes.title: Steven Snegov
scenes.summary: Nina sends Samson off on a business trip, telling him to call once he signs. She says he looks like a famous actor, and they dream of buying a big house.

scenes.title: The Frontera Car
scenes.summary: A customs officer checks Samson's papers and asks about his 2008 Frontera. Samson says he is hurrying to Sineozersk, and the officer lets him go.

scenes.title: Meeting at the Airport
scenes.summary: Samson waits three hours for a delayed plane and runs into his old army friend Tarachkov. Tarachkov suggests a nearby casino, and Samson offers to treat him.

scenes.title: Beginner's Luck
scenes.summary: Samson bets on red at roulette and keeps winning. Tarachkov urges him to stop, but Samson wants eighty thousand to buy a construction company and bets again.

scenes.title: The Casino Winnings
scenes.summary: A croupier hands Samson his winnings, but Samson insists on betting all his money on red. Rozhok warns him to go home, and the wheel spins.

scenes.title: Down to Zero
scenes.summary: Samson and Rozhok lose everything on the roulette table. Rozhok urges Samson to leave, and Samson says he must win the money back.

scenes.title: After the Loss
scenes.summary: Outside, Samson says the lost money was for his mother-in-law's apartment and that he does not know what to tell Nina. Rozhok tells him to go home and rest.

scenes.title: Confession to Nina
scenes.summary: Samson admits to Nina that nobody robbed him and that he was afraid she would leave. Nina forgives him and says they will handle it together.

scenes.title: The Plan and the Money
scenes.summary: Pasha tells Denis about an important meeting at three o'clock at an abandoned warehouse outside town. Denis says money should always be counted.

scenes.title: A Call to the Governor
scenes.summary: Arkady phones Governor Viktor Stepanovich and says the cluster is a deception and everyone will be arrested. He says he has a plan and wants his freedom and the mayor's seat.

scenes.title: Handing Over the Money
scenes.summary: Panov meets Pasha at a warehouse and says six bags of money are ready. They agree to load the bags, and Pasha mentions a press conference later.

scenes.title: Raid at the Warehouse
scenes.summary: A special forces commander orders everyone onto the floor and announces arrests. Pasha pleads that it is a mistake and asks for a lawyer.

scenes.title: Special Operation at the Warehouse
scenes.summary: Major Lavrov's FSB team and Governor Viktor Stepanovich's police both turn up at the warehouse. They agree to treat it as a joint operation and document the arrest together.

scenes.title: Defending the Monastery
scenes.summary: Samson asks Marina to end the protest and go home. Marina refuses to leave the students, so Samson says they will stay and stand beside her.

scenes.title: The Builders' Retreat
scenes.summary: Builders pack up and leave after their boss says the wall will not be touched. Marina mocks their retreat and says the wall is saved.

scenes.title: Memory of Father
scenes.summary: Father Grigory tells Marina she reminds him of her father, who also defended the truth. Marina says they defended their shared heritage and the wall is saved.

scenes.title: Historical Heritage
scenes.summary: A lawyer tells Christian that damaging historical monuments can mean prison. He says experts are checking the wall, and they go to prepare documents.

scenes.title: Detention by the Wall
scenes.summary: Marina asks an officer to release a young man who was defending the wall. The officer agrees, tells everyone to disperse, and warns against breaking public order.

scenes.title: Interrogation by the Khan
scenes.summary: At a reenactment, the Khan threatens the captured warrior Kostik. Kostik at first defies him, then gives in and says the treasure is by the old oak.

scenes.title: Caviar with the Governor
scenes.summary: Governor Viktor Stepanovich is pleased about seventeen thousand new online followers. Arkady mentions his broken finger and asks about his bracelet, and the governor says it is solved and offers caviar.

scenes.title: Call from Moscow
scenes.summary: Pyotr phones the governor and says he is being considered for a minister post. He says it requires a payment of one hundred fifty million, and the governor agrees to find it.

scenes.title: Minister of Fisheries
scenes.summary: The governor tells his aide Stepanych he will soon become minister of fisheries. Stepanych congratulates him, and they leave for the residence.

scenes.title: All for the Minister Post
scenes.summary: Arkady asks if all the money is only for the minister post. Viktor Stepanovich says Moscow never bargains, promises to make Arkady governor, and has the bags loaded.

scenes.title: Fishing at the Lake
scenes.summary: Governor Viktor Stepanovich takes Arkady ice fishing to discuss his appointment privately. They toast his future post, and the fish are not biting.

scenes.title: Stepanovich's Betrayal
scenes.summary: Viktor Stepanovich informs Arkady that he cannot make him governor or mayor and refuses to let him go.

scenes.title: At the Ice Hole
scenes.summary: Viktor Stepanovich orders his thugs to strip Arkady and drown him in an ice hole despite his desperate pleas.

scenes.title: Rescued from the Ice
scenes.summary: FSB officers rescue Arkady from freezing water and arrest Viktor Stepanovich on the spot.

scenes.title: The Deal with the FSB
scenes.summary: Arkady proposes an elaborate sting operation against the governor in exchange for his freedom, but Marina takes charge of the negotiations.

scenes.title: Sitting Before the Journey
scenes.summary: The Samsonov family packs their bags and prepares for the journey to Siberia.

scenes.title: Pasha's Conscience
scenes.summary: Samsonov confronts Pasha over his ruthless violence and asks if he has a conscience.

scenes.title: A Good Boss
scenes.summary: The characters reflect on morality, greed, and what makes a truly good leader.

scenes.title: Meeting with the Minister
scenes.summary: Arkady and the team celebrate their successful meeting with the Minister of Culture.
